events.title: Cyclone Gaja
events.summary: A cyclone formed in the Bay of Bengal and made landfall on the coast of Tamil Nadu, southern India.
events.source_name: India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi), cyclone report

events.title: Cyclone Nisarga
events.summary: A cyclone formed over the Arabian Sea and made landfall on the west coast of Maharashtra, India.
events.source_name: India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi), preliminary report

events.title: Cyclone Fani
events.summary: A cyclone formed in the Bay of Bengal and came ashore near Puri on the coast of Odisha, eastern India.
events.source_name: India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi), cyclone report
